corpus.label: corpus-2
corpus.note: A private corpus's tasks file lives outside this repository and is passed with --tasks; only its generic ids reach a results table. warm null: the corpus is not built, so every check is answer-based or restored. index_build: built once for its index store only (null or absent for none), so arm B answers callers from the store.

preamble: Text put before every prompt, e.g. that the repository cannot be built here.
answer_rule: End your reply with exactly one line that starts with ANSWER: and holds only the answer in the form the task asks for.

tasks.prompt: List every file that calls <the function>, other than the file that declares it. Give file names only, comma-separated.
List every file whose text contains <the name> as a whole word. Give repository-relative paths, comma-separated.
Which function decides to show '<the sentence>'? Give file: function.
<The symptom>. Find the bug and fix it. Do not change any test.
(1) <first question> (2) <second question, needing the first> ... Answer all in order, separated by ' | '.
